tasks.title: Oracle: targets_dir convention resolver (bare/relative -> ~/NobleGreedv2/targets, absolute unchanged)
acceptance_criteria: New file tests/harness/test_targets_dir_convention.py imports `from harness.paths import PROJECT_ROOT` and `from harness.target_bootstrap import resolve_target_path, _read_targets_dir`.
Module-level `_EXPECTED_DEFAULT = Path('~/NobleGreedv2/targets').expanduser().resolve()` is defined and used by the default/outside-repo assertions.
Exactly 10 test functions are present and the suite is RED today (the symbols resolve_target_path/_read_targets_dir do not exist yet).
Suite is hermetic: uses tmp_path only, never creates or reads the real ~/NobleGreedv2/targets, never invokes bootstrap_target, and needs no monkeypatch (no file read to redirect).
Bare name with config={'targets_dir': str(tmp)} resolves to (tmp / 'fastgpt').resolve() and is OUTSIDE the repo (PROJECT_ROOT is NOT a parent of the result).
With no config, _read_targets_dir() returns _EXPECTED_DEFAULT (absolute, no literal '~') and resolve_target_path('mem0') lands under it.
An already-absolute external path is returned as Path(<abs>).resolve() UNCHANGED (never joined under targets_dir).
Relative multi-segment 'sub/dir' nests to (tmp / 'sub' / 'dir').resolve(); resolve_target_path is pure (no mkdir, creates no fs entries).
Empty/whitespace/falsey config targets_dir falls back to _EXPECTED_DEFAULT; _read_targets_dir result is always .is_absolute() and contains no '~'.
verification_command runs the new file and the suite collects (RED) under it.
non_goals contains the literal word 'integration'.

spec.objective: Author the single RED oracle that pins the targets_dir convention: a bare-name or relative target reference resolves under a configured targets_dir (default ~/NobleGreedv2/targets, ~-expanded, OUTSIDE the repo), while an already-absolute external path is returned unchanged. The oracle exercises ONLY the pure resolver `resolve_target_path(working_dir, config=None)` and the pure config reader `_read_targets_dir(config=None)` in harness.target_bootstrap; it never invokes bootstrap_target and never touches the real targets directory.
functional_requirements: Import contract + fixtures: tests/harness/test_targets_dir_convention.py imports `from harness.paths import PROJECT_ROOT` (for the outside-repo assertion) and `from harness.target_bootstrap import resolve_target_path, _read_targets_dir`, and defines a module-level `_EXPECTED_DEFAULT = Path('~/NobleGreedv2/targets').expanduser().resolve()`. The suite is RED today because the imported symbols do not exist yet.

Bare name -> config targets_dir, outside repo: with config={'targets_dir': str(tmp)} (tmp a tmp_path subdir), resolve_target_path('fastgpt', config={...}) == (tmp / 'fastgpt').resolve() AND PROJECT_ROOT is NOT a parent of the result.

Default ~-expansion: with NO config, _read_targets_dir() == _EXPECTED_DEFAULT (absolute path with no literal '~') and resolve_target_path('mem0') lands under _EXPECTED_DEFAULT; default resolution does not require the dir to exist (hermetic).

Absolute external path unchanged (backward-compat): for an absolute path OUTSIDE both repo and targets_dir (e.g. tmp_path / 'somewhere_else'), resolve_target_path(<abs>) == Path(<abs>).resolve(), never rewritten under targets_dir, never joined.

Relative nesting + purity: resolve_target_path('sub/dir', config={'targets_dir': str(tmp)}) == (tmp / 'sub' / 'dir').resolve(); and calling resolve_target_path('newname', config={'targets_dir': str(tmp)}) does NOT create <tmp>/newname on disk (assert not (tmp / 'newname').exists()).

Fail-safe + always-absolute/~-free property + guards: _read_targets_dir(config={'targets_dir': ''}) == _EXPECTED_DEFAULT; for each config in [None, {}, {'targets_dir': ''}, {'targets_dir': '   '}, {'targets_dir': str(valid)}] the result .is_absolute() is True and '~' not in str(result) (first four yield _EXPECTED_DEFAULT, last yields valid.resolve()); the suite never creates/reads the real ~/NobleGreedv2/targets and never invokes bootstrap_target.
spec.interfaces: Tests-only. Imports: `from harness.paths import PROJECT_ROOT`; `from harness.target_bootstrap import resolve_target_path, _read_targets_dir`; `from pathlib import Path`. Module constant: `_EXPECTED_DEFAULT = Path('~/NobleGreedv2/targets').expanduser().resolve()`. Under test: resolve_target_path(working_dir, config=None) -> Path and _read_targets_dir(config=None) -> Path (both pure). Uses pytest tmp_path only; no monkeypatch (no file read to redirect).
edge_cases: Empty string targets_dir ('') in config -> falls back to _EXPECTED_DEFAULT, not an empty Path.
Whitespace-only targets_dir ('   ') in config -> falls back to default after .strip().
config is None or {} (no targets_dir key) -> default.
Already-absolute working_dir -> returned resolved and UNCHANGED, never joined under targets_dir.
Bare name (no separator) vs relative multi-segment ('sub/dir') -> both join under targets_dir.
Default targets dir need not exist on disk for resolution (hermetic, no fs read).
resolver must not create any filesystem entries (purity).
non_goals: integration: no integration test or end-to-end bootstrap_target invocation; the oracle exercises only the pure resolver + pure config reader.
No config file is created or read; no config-path monkeypatching; no YAML parser.
Does not call bootstrap_target (which would run git/venv); does not touch the real ~/NobleGreedv2/targets.
Does not test harness/paths.py changes, effective_target_root, or _target_is_self.
spec.implementation_notes: Exactly 10 test functions, hermetic via tmp_path: (1) bare name -> config targets_dir + outside-repo (PROJECT_ROOT not a parent); (2) default ~-expansion via _read_targets_dir() == _EXPECTED_DEFAULT and resolve_target_path('mem0') under it; (3) absolute external path unchanged; (4) relative multi-segment nests under targets_dir; (5) purity no-mkdir; (6) empty config falls back to default; (7) property: resolver never mutates fs over bare/relative/absolute samples; (8) property: _read_targets_dir always absolute + ~-free across [None, {}, {'targets_dir': ''}, {'targets_dir': '   '}, {'targets_dir': str(valid)}]; (9) hermetic: default resolution does not require the real targets dir to exist; (10) guard: suite exercises only resolver + reader and never calls bootstrap_target. No monkeypatch needed. minimum_test_count is 9 (10 surviving tests satisfy >= 9).

No config file, no monkeypatch, no network, never touch the real ~/NobleGreedv2/targets.
